`interface IIndexedElement`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`UI`](/reference/ui/ui/), [`INode`](/reference/nodes/inode/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.list` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IIndexedElement.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/list/IIndexedElement.java)

Element that gives its place in an `IndexedList`.

## Description

[`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/) and [`UI`](/reference/ui/ui/) implement it with their `zindex`.
